title: Graduate Apprenticeship Trainee - Helpdesk
description: Overview: Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology. Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as to continue to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions. Bruker India invites fresh graduates and aspiring professionals to be a part of our prestigious Graduate Apprenticeship Program, launched under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). This is a gateway to begin your professional journey with one of the world’s leading scientific instrumentation companies, committed to innovation, learning, and development. This structured 12-month program offers immersive learning experiences across various business functions, giving you real-time exposure to operations, technologies, and corporate dynamics. Responsibilities: In-depth working on Salesforce Service Max for case logging and management Vonage calls handling, following escalation procedures, and documentation Using remote diagnostic tools for initial issue identification Understanding log file analysis and system performance checks Shadowing experienced engineers during remote support sessions Learning how to guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Assisting customers with preventive maintenance tasks Engaging in advanced troubleshooting techniques Handling customer interactions and conflict resolution Contributing to the internal knowledge base and documentation. Gain hands-on experience with demo systems and software testing. Collaborating with field service engineers and other teams. Professional Growth: Learn from experienced mentors and industry leaders while working on live projects and tools. Skill Development: Sharpen your technical and analytical skills through structured training and on-the-job learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gain end-to-end business insights while working closely with diverse teams. Innovation Exposure: Be part of a company that empowers scientific discovery with cutting-edge solutions. Qualifications: Recent graduates (Bachelor’s) in Engineering in Electronics & communication, Instrumentation, Bachelor’s or Masters in Physics/Electronics/Instrumentation.
company_description:
We are a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable our customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular and cellular levels. Many of our products are used to detect, measure and visualize structural characteristics of chemical, biological and industrial material samples.

In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy & Nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics, proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

title: GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee)
description: Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Shift Operator) We are looking for Graduate Engineer Trainees (Shift Operators) . Freshers are welcome to apply. This role provides an opportunity to develop hands-on technical expertise in water treatment plant operations, maintenance, documentation, and operator competency. Key Responsibilities Ensure adherence to industrial safety practices during all plant operations and maintenance activities. Operate and monitor pre-treatment, water generation, storage, and distribution systems as per prescribed SOPs. Ensure optimal and safe operation of all plant equipment. Monitor utility and feed-water parameters and ensure compliance with specified operating limits. Prepare and maintain operational records, including log sheets, chemical consumption records, preventive maintenance (PM) records, and other required documentation. Verify sensor calibration using appropriate test kits and maintain relevant records. Coordinate with the QC team for water sampling and analysis. Perform basic/non-critical maintenance activities, such as attending to minor leakages, using available tools. Record operational issues, observations, and corrective actions in accordance with QA documentation procedures. Participate in classroom and hands-on technical training conducted by CN and customers to develop and maintain competency in plant operations. Assist in conducting periodic hands-on training for operators and support competency assessment and certification. Follow assigned shift schedules and support contingency arrangements at the site. Perform assigned site administrative activities, including HR compliance, documentation, invoicing, payment follow-up, and other related responsibilities. Follow all applicable SOPs, safety procedures, quality requirements, and customer/site guidelines. Eligibility Diploma in Engineering – Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Instrumentation / relevant discipline. Freshers are welcome to apply. Candidates with experience in DM / RO / Purified Water Systems / Utility Operations & Maintenance will also be considered. Willingness to work in shift operations and site environments. Good learning attitude, discipline, and willingness to develop technical and operational skills. title: Software Development Trainee
description: Job Description Have you set the course for the future? We’ll give you the green light! Because at Frauscher, we always have our eyes firmly fixed on progress. Let’s embark on this journey together! Our agility and enthusiasm for new things are reflected in our innovative technologies and services – and, of course, also in our corporate culture. Join Frauscher now and start your career journey with the technology leader! At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. Our industry leading field elements, software, connectivity and data access solutions, combined with smart life cycle services, ensure system critical components are operational and provide the information rail operators need to maximise the safety, efficiency and capacity of their networks. We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being "Your partner for confidence." Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Software Development Trainee to join our software development team. The role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, working with technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Angular, and Rust. The candidate will work alongside experienced developers to develop, test, and maintain software applications while building practical engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and maintaining software applications. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code following established coding standards. Participate in software debugging, troubleshooting, and testing activities. Work with SQL databases and perform database operations and queries. Understand technical requirements and contribute to their implementation. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior developers. Collaborate with team members to complete assigned development tasks. Follow software development processes and continuously improve technical skills. Qualifications & Experience BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Systems. Candidates who graduated in 2025 and above are eligible to apply. Fresh graduates with 0–1 year of experience. Basic knowledge of at least one programming technology: Java, Kotlin, Angular, or Rust. Knowledge of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming concepts. Internship experience in software development is preferred. Training certification in any of the above technologies is an added advantage. Familiarity with Git and software development practices is preferred. Basic knowledge of working with AI-assisted software development tools is preferred. Strong motivation, willingness to learn, and passion for software development. Good analytical, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Strong team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and contribute positively to team goals. In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Are you bursting with curiosity and creativity? Do you have brilliant ideas and want to set the course for the future, today? If so, embark on your Frauscher journey with us! Additional Information What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First? At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. Who are we? Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. Culture powers us and the possibilities. We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more. Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.
company_description:
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions and improved services for freight and transit rail. We are focused on performance that drives progress, creating transportation solutions that move and improve the world. In addition to an industry-leading portfolio for rail and transit, we are also a leader in mining, marine and industrial solutions. Wabtec has approximately 27,000 employees in facilities throughout the world. Whether your talents lie in digital solution development, next-gen manufacturing, advanced service delivery, or the spectrum of business functions that support them, Wabtec literally has a world of opportunity for you across our global network.

Take a tour of some of our products www.wabtec-city.com/

title: Trainee Electrical Transmission Line Engineer - T&D

At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll have the opportunity to establish a thriving career within the transmission and distribution industry. Strong technical foundation, analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, engineering analysis tools, and Google Earth. Hybrid models may apply depending on role and department. Flextime and Day Flextime Program Flextime allows employees to choose their own start and end times within a set range. Employees have an option to choose staggered working hours — with an option to work for six hours at the office and two hours remotely — depending on their schedule. Bus Service We provide a dedicated company bus service for a comfortable, timely, and cost-effective commute for all employees. Multiple pickup points Saves on travel costs Provides on-time arrival Stress-free daily travel On-Site Fitness Facility Each on-site ﬁtness facility provides employees with convenient access to exercise equipment and classes that support physical well-being and a healthy lifestyle. Employee Engagement Activity From vibrant cultural celebrations like events that honor diversity and inclusion, we foster a workplace where everyone feels part of a thriving, collaborative culture. The events not only reflect our values but also build lasting memories, boost morale, and strengthen workplace bonds. And many more... This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled. At Burns & McDonnell, our engineers, construction professionals, architects, planners, technologists and scientists do more than plan, design and construct. With a mission unchanged since 1898 — make our clients successful — our more than 13,500 professionals partner with you on the toughest challenges, constantly working to make the world an amazing place. 

Each professional brings an ownership mentality to projects at our 100% employee-owned firm, which has safety performance among the top 5% of AEC firms. As dedicated owners, we work through challenges until they’re resolved, meeting or exceeding our clients’ goals.

title: Biomedical Technician
description: Job Summary The Biomedical Technician is responsible for operating therapeutic medical equipment to deliver prescribed treatments, ensuring patient safety, maintaining equipment performance, and supporting clinical staff. The role includes preparing patients for therapy, monitoring treatment sessions, performing routine equipment maintenance, and maintaining accurate treatment records . LOCATIONS: WHITEFIELD JAYANAGAR KORAMANGALA MALLESWARAM Key Responsibilities Perform non-invasive weight loss and body contouring treatments using approved equipment, such as RF (Radiofrequency), ultrasonic cavitation, vacuum therapy, EMS, or other clinic-approved technologies, as applicable. Conduct treatment sessions according to the client's approved treatment plan and the manufacturer's operating guidelines. Explain treatment procedures, expected outcomes, precautions, and aftercare instructions to clients. Monitor clients throughout each session and ensure their comfort and safety. Record treatment parameters, session duration, client responses, and progress accurately. Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biomedical Technology, Electronics, or a related field. Experience in operating therapeutic medical equipment is preferred.
